summary: Discharge under Section 227 CrPC; standard: prima facie case, not full evidence; omission to provide safety gear not automatically criminal; rash/negligent act required; High Court's 'prudent person' standard misapplied; accident vs culpable homicide; strong suspicion insufficient for charge; compensation paid by appellants; educational support and employment provided to victims' families; no overt act or knowledge of death-causing injury.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; charge against appellants quashed; criminal proceedings set aside.
